name: Labaco — Ride-Hailing Platform
description: A ride-hailing platform built for underserved regional areas, published on both Google Play Store and App Store.
features: Built backend and web frontend using CodeIgniter
Developed cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter
Integrated Google Maps, Firebase chat & push notifications, Xendit payment gateway
Optimized map costs by using Mapbox for routing and rendering on Google Maps

name: Smart Hydroponic IoT System
description: An IoT-based hydroponic automation system to control water pH and temperature, recognized as Top 10 Winner in Telkom Indonesia Innovillage competition.
features: Real-time monitoring and control through an Android application
Firebase Realtime Database for live data synchronization
Arduino as sensor controller and actuator trigger for pumps and nutrient control
